files.line: On Intel(R) Xeon(R) Platinum 8370C CPU @ 2.80GHz: Google's 0.30% holds for forward loops with loops aligned (at most 0.2% on k01_sum_fwd, k02_add_fwd, k03_stencil); a loop that loses vectorization under the same check (k04_rev, k05_stride2, k08_matmul) pays 4.90 times (range 3.92 to 6.15; as compiled 5.11), because it loses SIMD. Placement-sensitive, listed and not counted: k02_add_fwd.L1 (as compiled 1.07, aligned 1.05); k03_stencil.L2 (as compiled 0.99, aligned 1.00).
files.why: MAP: every counted in-cache cell of k01_sum_fwd, k02_add_fwd, k03_stencil has aligned ratio <= 1.02 and aligned ci95_hi <= 1.0200; every in-cache cell of k04_rev, k05_stride2, k08_matmul has ci95_lo >= 1.5 in both columns; placement-sensitive (layout A/A half-width 0.25%): k02_add_fwd.L1, k03_stencil.L2
